why: One registry so that 'code exists', 'something was executed once' and 'an external project can adopt this' can never be averaged into a single flattering word.
rules: integration=ADOPTED requires a named external project running the surface, with evidence committed.
integration=PILOT requires a named external partner and a committed pilot record; a plan is not a pilot.
execution=EXECUTED means a committed artifact proves the call happened; it says nothing about adoptability.
code=BUILT_UNVERIFIED means the file exists but no test or executed artifact covers it.
No single combined label may replace these three axes anywhere in docs/.

surfaces.label: Stellar integration adapter (read / build / submit gate)
surfaces.note: Reads Horizon and builds intents; submission only through an injected submitter. No live integration, no customer.

surfaces.label: Soroban commitment anchor (contract + first commit call)
surfaces.note: Deployed to Stellar mainnet and commit() INVOKED by the owner's own script. No external project calls it.

surfaces.label: DEX gating against the real order book (DEX-GATE/1)
surfaces.note: Five verdicts computed against the live XLM/USDC book. Returns PLAN_ONLY; it never sends.

surfaces.label: Agent payment gate, policy matrix (STELLAR-AGENT/1)
surfaces.note: VERIFIED / REJECTED / HELD matrix executed offline; submit NOT_PERFORMED (credential-gated).

surfaces.label: Agent payment gate + signed receipts + independent verifier (AGENT-GATE/1)
surfaces.note: The flagship surface: refuses an envelope that diverges from the authorized intent, including a batched second payment. No signer, no submission, no chain read.

surfaces.label: Freighter wallet wrapper
surfaces.note: No end-to-end test: there is no browser wallet in CI and no credential path. Credential-gated, not proven.

surfaces.label: Mainnet executor (payment / invoke / anchor)
surfaces.note: Returns PLAN_OK plus sample code. It is a planning surface, correctly labelled PLAN_ONLY.

surfaces.label: Independent receipt verifier (offline, no CoreGuard server)
surfaces.note: Verifies committed evidence packages; adoption by a third party is 0.

surfaces.label: Agentic escrow arbitration adapter
surfaces.note: DRY_RUN / NOT_BUILT by design; structurally unable to claim a live call.

surfaces.label: People's Court attestation adapter
surfaces.note: Fail-closed intake only. A read-only review is not an integration, an endorsement or adoption.
